facts.text: Everything has a price, John. In my house the price is a good meal first, and then we talk about the dogs.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Sofia's words, but she never says it. Her real lines on the quote page include 'Nothing's ever just a conversation with you, John.' and 'He shot my dog.' The 'everything has a price' line is Iosef's in the first film.
facts.fix: "Nothing's ever just a conversation with you, John."

fix_note.text: Nothing's ever just a conversation with you, John.

facts.text: Serve the sushi when John walks into Zero's sushi counter.
facts.why: John does not walk into the sushi counter. Zero prepares fugu at a sushi bar and serves it to the Adjudicator, who has been sent to clean up after John.
facts.fix: Serve the sushi when the Adjudicator sits down at Zero's sushi bar.

facts.text: Serve the sushi when John walks into Zero's sushi counter.
facts.why: Same as the printed cue: the sushi bar scene is Zero serving the Adjudicator, not John walking in.
facts.fix: Serve the sushi when the Adjudicator sits down at Zero's sushi bar.

facts.text: The streets around Zero's sushi counter.
facts.why: Chinatown and streets around a sushi counter are not in the plot. Zero's sushi bar is where he serves the Adjudicator, so the note now only claims his knife work.
facts.fix: Knife work worthy of Zero's sushi bar.

vibe.verdict: Moody club look and a good Casablanca setting, but it is built around a sushi scene it can't back up and misses the film's funniest food line.
